components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view (Adicionar totem, Salvar, Copiar código). Blue 700 fill: white on #42b0d5 is only ~2.6:1.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Adicionar totem</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 14px/1 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: #fff; background: oklch(from #42b0d5 calc(l - 0.18) c h); border: 1px solid oklch(from #42b0d5 calc(l - 0.18) c h); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(from #034a5d calc(l + 0.08) c h); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.08), 0 2px 4px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.13 230 / 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font: 600 12px/1 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); background: oklch(0.94 0.010 230); border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.014 230); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.89 0.014 230); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.13 230 / 0.35); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions (Excluir totem, Encerrar todas, Expulsar), always behind the confirm dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font: 600 14px/1 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.58 0.20 25); background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.58 0.20 25 / 0.35); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.06 25); border-color: oklch(0.58 0.20 25); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.13 230 / 0.35); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields and the top-bar search. Mono face for addresses and JSON.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); } .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.80 0.018 230); border-radius: 10px; transition: border-color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.65 0.020 230); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.65 0.020 230); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #42b0d5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.13 230 / 0.35); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: DS badge: tone-100 fill, tone ink text, optional pulsing dot when people are playing.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font: 600 12px/1.4 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.42 0.024 230); background: oklch(0.94 0.010 230); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge--success { color: oklch(0.45 0.12 155); background: oklch(0.94 0.05 155); } .ds-badge--success::before { animation: ds-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); } }

components.name: Totem Card
components.description: White card, 16px radius, the only surface with a resting shadow; lifts on hover.

components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 20px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.014 230); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.06), 0 1px 1px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.04); transition: box-shadow 180ms, transform 180ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.08), 0 2px 4px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.05); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); } .ds-card__tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 11px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: oklch(0.52 0.022 230); background: oklch(0.94 0.010 230); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-card__meta { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: oklch(0.52 0.022 230); }

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.description: Dashboard filter tabs with count pills (Todos / Totem físico / Web).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.014 230); font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: -1px; padding: 10px 4px; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Poppins', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.52 0.022 230); background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); } .ds-tab.is-on { font-weight: 600; color: oklch(from #42b0d5 calc(l - 0.18) c h); border-bottom-color: #42b0d5; } .ds-tab span { padding: 1px 7px; font: 600 11px/1.4 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: oklch(0.65 0.020 230); background: oklch(0.94 0.010 230); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-tab.is-on span { color: oklch(from #42b0d5 calc(l - 0.18) c h); background: #c7f1ff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.72 0.13 230 / 0.35); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: DS card toast: white, 3px tone edge, title + message, bottom-right.
components.css: .ds-toast { width: 320px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; background: #fff; border-left: 3px solid oklch(0.62 0.14 155); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.12), 0 4px 8px oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.06); } .ds-toast__t { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.16 0.028 230); } .ds-toast__m { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.52 0.022 230); }

components.name: Gamepad Face Button
components.description: Signature: Xbox ABXY on the phone controller only (Xbox Quarantine Rule).
components.css: .ds-face { width: 64px; height: 64px; font: 700 22px/1 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.08s, box-shadow 0.08s, filter 0.08s; } .ds-face:active { transform: scale(0.87) translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 oklch(0.16 0.028 230 / 0.15); filter: brightness(1.35); } .ds-face:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #42b0d5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-face--a { background: #107c10; } .ds-face--b { background: #e23c28; }

narrative.northStar: The Control Room, on DreamBricks Blue
narrative.overview:
Street Arcade is built on the DreamBricks Design System — light, blue-tinted slate surfaces, thin 1px borders and one confident accent (DreamBricks Blue) doing all the 'this is interactive' signalling — merged with the two things the brand has no answer for: monospace for anything that is live system data, and the Xbox ABXY palette on the phone gamepad.

The operator dashboard is the DS UI kit shell: ink sidebar with the wordmark and J0Bson, a white top bar, stat cards, underline tabs, quiet cards with a whisper of shadow, native dialogs and card toasts, kept live by one operator stream. Player screens share one centered composition with the mark or the waving mascot. Reliable first, playful second: personality shows up in motion and state (queue position bump, pulsing live dot, tactile face buttons), never in decoration.

Typography is Poppins (standing in for the brandbook's Araboto, which is not licensed yet) for everything a human reads and IBM Plex Mono for every system fact.
keyCharacteristics: Light, blue-tinted slate base; never dark-mode-by-default; the ink sidebar is the one dark surface
One accent: DreamBricks Blue for focus/active; Blue 700 for filled buttons and chart bars
Poppins for words, IBM Plex Mono for live/system data
Cards carry --shadow-sm at rest; everything else is flat; depth grows only on hover, toast and dialog
Saturated colour only in status badges, the live dot and the four gamepad face buttons

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: DreamBricks Blue is the only colour that means primary action or focused/active. A second action is secondary/ghost, never a second hue.

rules.name: The Xbox Quarantine Rule
rules.body: The Xbox four-colour palette exists only inside the gamepad's face buttons.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: IDs, timers, IPs, ports, queue positions and other system facts render in IBM Plex Mono; sentences to humans in Poppins.

rules.name: The Quiet-Card Rule
rules.body: --shadow-sm belongs to cards only; bars, inputs, badges and resting buttons never carry a shadow.

dos: Do keep the base UI light and quiet — slate page, white cards with --shadow-sm, 1px borders, an ink sidebar.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for live/system data and Poppins for everything else.
Do let DreamBricks Blue carry every primary action and focus state; second colours only from Success/Danger/Warning.
Do confine the Xbox palette to the gamepad face buttons.
Do tint every shadow with Ink, never pure black.
Do keep motion purposeful and quick (120–280ms, the 2s live pulse).
donts: Don't build a gray enterprise-admin screen, nor neon/cyberpunk gamer aesthetics.
Don't add a resting shadow to anything that isn't a card, and never a zero-offset coloured glow.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't reach for SweetAlert or window.confirm; use the confirm dialog and the DS toast.
Don't commit font files: the repo is public and Araboto is not licensed.
